name: 살게
subject: 소라게
look_en: Small hermit crab with a rounded body in amber #c7891d, one oversized claw and very simplified short stubby legs. Its shell is a block-shaped mini building in warm cream #f3efe7 with deep green #1f6b4f windows, one window glowing warm amber. Swappable shell types: small cube studio, tall slim officetel tower, stacked layered apartment. Peeks out of the shell with tiny dot eyes and a calm, satisfied half-smile, claw holding a small key. Soft matte 3D clay render, solid colors, clean studio lighting, minimal background. Sophisticated and trustworthy, not childish.

name: 처마
subject: 제비
look_en: Chubby front-facing swallow with a round teardrop-shaped body, short forked tail and small stubby wings. Head and back in deep green #1f6b4f, belly in warm cream #f3efe7, small throat patch in amber #c7891d. Tiny dot eyes, small rounded beak, confident friendly smile with one eye winking. Holds a small notepad and pencil, a soft measuring tape hanging from one wing. Soft matte 3D clay render, simple solid colors, gentle studio lighting, minimal background. Stylish and reliable, not childish.

name: 창봄
subject: 불 켜진 창문
look_en: Rounded-square window frame character in deep green #1f6b4f with a thin warm cream #f3efe7 outline, cross-shaped mullions dividing four panes. The upper two panes glow warm amber #c7891d and act as eyes, curved into happy half-moon shapes. A small cream curtain drapes on one side, a tiny potted plant sits on the windowsill. Short stubby arms extend from the frame sides. Soft matte 3D clay render, warm interior glow, simple solid colors, clean lighting, minimal background. Calm and sophisticated, not childish.

name: 반디
subject: 반딧불이
look_en: Bean-shaped firefly with a deep green #1f6b4f body and a thin warm cream #f3efe7 outline, small translucent cream wings, and a round glowing tail light in amber #c7891d. Two small dot eyes, short antennae, relaxed friendly smile. A soft sleep mask pushed up on its forehead and a tiny headset with a microphone. Soft matte 3D clay render, gentle warm glow from the tail, simple solid colors, night-time ambient lighting, minimal background. Cozy and trustworthy, not childish.

name: 재요
subject: 줄자
look_en: Round tape-measure case as the body in deep green #1f6b4f, with a simple face on the front. The pulled-out tape strip is warm cream #f3efe7 with amber #c7891d tick marks and works like an arm or tail. Thin round glasses and a pencil tucked at the side. Tiny dot eyes, attentive and slightly proud but warm smile. Short stubby feet. Soft matte 3D clay render, simple solid colors, clean studio lighting, minimal background. Meticulous yet friendly, sophisticated, not childish.
